sections.t: Upper A done with a 38-minute session. The easy run was 2.2 km at 7:53/km, short of the planned 3 km and faster than your easy range.
Rest day. An easy walk is fine as recovery, and get set for Lower B tomorrow, starting with the hip thrust machine 4x6-10.
Keep protein high on the rest day too, near 130 g spread over three or four meals within about 1,750 kcal. Try Protein overnight oats for breakfast and Hake with lentils for dinner.

Your runs keep landing under 8:00/km, which is faster than easy for you. Slow to 8:30 to 9:00/km on Saturday's 3 km and Sunday's 3.3 km long run, with walk breaks if needed, so you can finish the full distance.
